National Statistics Office (NSO) Sub-Regional Office Solapur to conduct various surveys in the month of November 2026
articles.full_content:
Pune, 6 th November 2026
The National Statistics Office (NSO), Field Operations Division (FOD), Sub-Regional Office, Solapur, under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), is actively conducting a wide spectrum of socio-economic, industrial, and price-related surveys across the region. These nationwide surveys are pivotal in shaping national economic policies, calculating key indicators like GDP and inflation, evaluating employment trends, and assessing rural and urban socio-economic conditions. Below is an overview of the key ongoing survey operations undertaken by NSO SRO Solapur.
1. Continuous & Ongoing Socio-Economic Surveys
• Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) [2026] Objective: Launched to provide key employment and unemployment indicators—such as Worker Population Ratio (WPR), Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR), and Unemployment Rate (UR). Frequency of Indicators: Monthly for both rural and urban areas under Current Weekly Status (CWS), Quarterly for both rural and urban areas under Current Weekly Status (CWS) and annually for both rural and urban areas under Usual Status ps+ss and CWS. Survey Plan in November 2026 - Field work of PLFS 2026 is planned in the following areas under the jurisdiction of Sub Regional Office, Solapur in November 2026:
• Objective: Launched to provide key employment and unemployment indicators—such as Worker Population Ratio (WPR), Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR), and Unemployment Rate (UR).
• Frequency of Indicators: Monthly for both rural and urban areas under Current Weekly Status (CWS), Quarterly for both rural and urban areas under Current Weekly Status (CWS) and annually for both rural and urban areas under Usual Status ps+ss and CWS.
• Survey Plan in November 2026 - Field work of PLFS 2026 is planned in the following areas under the jurisdiction of Sub Regional Office, Solapur in November 2026:
Solapur District
• Solapur MC (Mallikarjun Nagar, Ramabai Ambedkar Garden New Budhwarpeth, Ambikanagar Bale, Vimanpatal Parisar, CNS Hospital Area)
• Mangalwedha (Kodumbhari Gali)
• Sangola (Ganpatrao Deshmukh Vidyalaya Parisar)
• Sangramnagar(Tamboli Basti)
Dharashiv District
• Dharashiv (Bhanunagar, Bagwan Gali)
Solapur District
• Arjunsond (Tal - Mohol),
• Kudal (Tal. Akkalkot),
• Hole (Tal - Pandharpur)
• Shivane (Tal - Sangola),
• Chicholi Kati (Tal - Mohol),
• Nimbhore (Tal - Karmala),
• Khave (Tal - Mangalwedha)
• Kari (Tal - Barshi)
• Kurul (Tal - Mohol)
• Takli (Tal - Pandharpur)
• Jadhavwadi (Tal - Malshiras)
• Nimgaon (Tal - Malshiras)
• Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (ASUSE) [2026] Objective: Captures operational and economic metrics of unincorporated non-agricultural enterprises across manufacturing, trade, and non-construction service sectors to supplement corporate sector data. Survey Plan in November 2026 - Field work of ASUSE 2026 is planned in the following areas under the jurisdiction of Sub Regional Office, Solapur in November 2026:
• Object
